Plasma physics research has led to advances in semiconductor manufacturing and materials processing. Fusion technology has also driven innovations in vacuum systems and remote handling tools used in industrial applications. The iritic nature of these spin-off technologies demonstrates that fusion investment creates value across many sectors. Isotopic production for medical radioisotopes is another direct and important benefit of fusion research programs today.
